C0704.title: UK Couple Sentenced for £9M Automated Ticket Scalping Fraud
C0704.summary: Peter Hunter and David Smith used computer programs, 97 fake identities, and 112 credit cards between 2010 and 2017 to bulk-purchase tickets for concerts and events at face value, then resold them at inflated prices on secondary platforms like Viagogo and StubHub, generating approximately £9 million in profit.
